name: The Birds
alt: A blue parrot with a dark beak and orange eyes looks toward the camera from its enclosure.
introduction: A flash of color. A closer look. There is always something to be curious about.
story:
Birds are part of the community of animals at Critter Creek. These portraits offer a closer look at the details that make them so captivating.

Want to learn more about the birds and their care? Start a conversation with the ranch team when planning your visit.
care: Helping the ranch means helping with the continued, everyday care of its resident animals.
